134519.overview:
Beats of Rage is an open source brawler fighting game engine. The default game included with the engine is also called of Beats of Rage, and it is a 2D brawler inspired by the Street of Rage series. Players go through different levels in a city controlled by a criminal syndicate led by a Mr. Y. But three young friends, Kula Gem, Max Bacon and Mandy Bluegard can stop him.

The character sprites and some background art are taken from the King of Fighters games. Controls consists of four movement and three action keys. The player fights regular enemies and bosses. Some levels feature death drops where the player must avoid falling off, but can throw enemies into that void.

173840.overview:
Battletoads Double Dragon: The Revenge is a fan-made sequel to the 16-bit console hit from 1993, created using the OpenBOR engine and released in 2019 by MadGear.

Features:

• Choose from 5 playable characters: Rash, Zitz, Pimple, Billy, & Jimmy
• Play solo and save Marian alone or play simultaneously for classic 2-player co-op action
• Follow the story as you go through 8 missions
• 3 vehicle stages to crank up the action
• 4 extra bonus modes selectable from the start
• Detailed old-school cutscenes between missions
• Lots of different moves to crush your enemies with
• Familiar enemies and bosses from both the Battletoads and Double Dragon series
• Soundtrack consisting of songs from various Battletoads and Double Dragon games
• And many other features!

190390.overview: Battletoads Double Dragon IV: Return of The Dark Forces is a street fighting game, based on the Battletoads sagas from Tradewest and Double Dragon from Technos. The Toads from Battletoads and the brothers Billy and Jimmy from Double Dragon have returned, and once again they must hit the streets, beating everyone who gets in their way. This time, the characters of both games decide to meet to find out who is behind some explosions that affected the city and innocent people who had to flee their homes in search of refuge. During this period, enemies began to appear everywhere, turning the city into complete chaos. This is where frogs and humans unite to defend the population, using all their abilities and special moves to destroy this new threat.

192496.overview:
Bad ass babes is a video game using live action sprites and features a cheesy, B grade plot and over the top sexy moves.

Plot: Earth has been invaded by an alien race. Men are being captured and turned into mutant soldiers, whilst the women are being herded like cattle to be used for the alien breeding program. To survive the multiple births and to ensure the hybrid experiments are a success, the aliens endow the women with special strength and power. A few of these women are rising up against the invasion and plan to take on the aliens and anyone else in their way

192497.overview: A 4p Co-op game that deserves to be played. Good movements, spectacular powers. You can make combos and special attacks. 15 levels, 1 secret character and 3 game modes. A different, eclectic and original Beat em up game that mix characters from SNK,Konami,SEGA and more. Graphics are good, and sound are good.

192498.overview:
This Bare Knuckle Vacuum is a fan-made Streets of Rage based free MOD game designed by Chinese fan players Anking and Volcanic, with fresh originality and crafty designs.

-Key Features-
7 characters (1 hidden but selectable directly)
Excellent fighting systems with combos
Long levels
Many bosses
New and cool moves for each character
Usable improvised weapons
‘R.E.D. system’ similar to the magical attack in classic ‘Golden Axe’
The ability to use guns
4-player support

192499.overview: A mod that combines SoRRv4 and BKTNG, A full 8 stage mod with v4 music.

192500.overview:
Take the original Beats of Rage, swap the players for Batman sprites, the end.
Check this out to see one of the first Batman game attempts or a bit of OpenBOR's early history. 

This is a good OpenBOR game, was a first attempt of a Batman game (and I guess the only one in existence for Dreamcast console). You can select Batman or Robin or a "chick", and go through the streets taking justice of the Gotham city's villains. The graphics are good and refined. The development of moves and powers are ok but can be better. I modded sounds if you played standard version, you will recognise some sound modded immediately in this Dreamcast version. Titles, logo and select screen, etc also were modded. The game difficult is not hard, so I increase some boss life/power.

192502.overview:
The BattleToads are back, and they brought some friends along for the ride. Choose from a variety of missions, each one filled to the brim with all the humor and difficulty you'd expect from a BattleToads offering. When you're finished with that, try a dose of Comix Zone too!

This is a very early OpenBOR game, and proof positive that even with the then simple engine, a little creativity goes a long way. If you're up for some rat bashin' action, you've come to the right place!

192505.overview:
Beat of Fighting is a fan game of the brawler genre, created by Vanity Corp for the Openbor system. The game is based on SNK's arcade game Art of Fighting. Beat of Fighting is a beat'em up, in the style of games like Final Fight or Double Dragon, but with the huge fighters of Art of Fighting as protagonists and as enemies.

Peace and order reign in the city, but a new gang of gangsters, called Pantera, has arrived with the idea of ​​taking control, under the plan of their leader, Black Panther. However, there is hope, embodied in three heroes, Lion, Izumi and Big Daddy, who will try to prevent it.

192506.overview:
Beats of Rage Xtra is one of the games created by the Senile Team. Beats of Rage is the first game to start the OpenBoR saga, and Beats of Rage Xtra adds a new fresh atmosphere to this classic gameplay.
The characters do not have a large set of super skills or combos. In this feature, this game is more like its classic counterparts from more than a quarter of a century ago. However, the plot is interest and intense enough, and the animation is at an excellent level.

To the main characters Max, Mandy in Kula, other attractive characters from the King of Fighters have now been added. These are the elegant Rock, Terry, whose fiery elements sweep the enemy from afar. Also participating are ninja May and boxer Evie.

The soundtrack to the game is reminiscent of the cult series Streets of Rage, whose remake is Beats of Rage.

192508.overview:
There's no better inspiration for a beat'em up than the master of kung-fu himself: Bruce Lee. He's the main protagonist of Bruce Lee : Revenge of the Dragon, a side-scrolling action game similar to games such as Final Fight : Gold or Double Dragon III : The Dragon Stone.
The story tells us that Bruce rises from the dead and will go out for revenge on Dim Mak, fighting through the streets of Tokyo and Hong Kong. The narrative is reinforced by some static screens. Gameplay is great and although the graphics aren't perfect, they're very serviceable.
Fans of martial arts movies and of Bruce Lee himself are advised to try this game.

192509.overview:
This game is in a very unfinished state, but is a showcase of unique design aspects.

-Inventory menu to summon units, including NPC allies.
-Currency system (used to purchase units in game, or spawn spare fighters if player is defeated).
-Give special orders to AI controlled allies such as guard an area, protect an item, or follow the player.
-Tag system. Live swap which unit you control, while the AI takes over yours.
-Radar HUD. Monitor positions of ally and enemy units off-screen.

Tired of always playing the little guy underdog against big bad bosses? Turn the tables and join The Bruiser Brigade. Pick your favorite titan and go on a testosterone fuelled rampage. Get close and personal with tons of big brawling beat-down attacks and crushing chain grapples that never end until you say they've had enough! High-res screen gives you plenty of room to follow the action.

Little punks trying to gang up on you? No problem. Call in some allies to give you a hand and double the fun. Give them specific orders to strategize and outsmart your enemies.

192529.overview: A 2d Adventure Beat'em up game. Help Norimaru, a simple student, to escape from Bullying on the school! Use Terry and the Vampire Arcueid to destroy all demons.

192530.overview: Based on Bare Knuckle 3 which is what Streets of Rage 3 is called in Japan.

192533.overview: Early Version of Bare Knuckle Vacuum with 3 playable characters.

192540.overview: In this version of Beats of Rage, you can play as the Dragon Ball Z character Super Sayan along with The Original Characters Mandy and Kula. It includes four modes of play with limited levels.

192541.overview:
This is a remix of the original Beats of Rage game. The maps have been saved, but a new team of heroes has been added.

The available characters here are: Robert Garcia K.o.F. Chun Lee Street Fighter, Ryu Street Fighter, Vanessa K.o.F and the great Yamazaki K.o.F

192542.overview: Beats of Rage Remix is a BoR mod created by Mr.Q®, it is based on the original Beats of Rage and contains new music, different stages and different characters.

192549.overview:
Zier Fox is on a mission to locate his missing partner Zara.
He will need the help of his noble Silver Fox Revlis if he ever wants to find her.
Who has taken Zara, & why?

By its nature, this is a mod to the game Beats of Rage.
Great new fashion and creative techniques. Good animation, which will take you away from the classic techniques typical of the art of the game world.
Game! In fact, it is more of a story and a life travelogue. You will be able to immerse yourself in the spirit of the game and the main character, through the tools of OpenBoR which will allow you to take control of the character. And so line by line and arena after arena you can go through its entire path of development.

212892.overview:
Battletoads in BattleWorld Openbor developed by non-profit fans and with new characters, scenarios and many improvements and compatibility. The inclusion of new characters and scenarios that we could only dream of make it a fun game that you can try for free.

This fan game makes possible something like a remake of the game, with which it is possible to spend hours of fun thanks to the OpenBor graphics engine.

216843.overview:
Battletoads: NES Style is another game for the OpenBor engine based on the classic Nintendo Battletoads (8-Bits) created by the ingenious Sergio Sousa. This game includes 3 classic Battletoads characters, it also contains the soundtrack and sound of the N.E.S. version, as if that were not enough, it includes 7 back-levels with their respective weapons.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Battletoads: NES Style es otro juego para el motor OpenBor basandose del clasico de Battletoads de Nintendo (8-Bits) creado por el ingenioso SergioSousa. Este juego incluye 3 personajes clasico de Battletoads, ademas contiene la banda sonora y sonido de la version de N.E.S., como si fuese poco incluye 7 retro-niveles con sus respectivas armas.

447873.overview: You are tasked to turn up the heat of the facility. There are vile pests around so get upgrades to help you killing them. Don't forget to sweep the weeds also! After the heat has reached maximum level, return to where you started.

463691.overview: Kungpow's Sailor Moon Collection is a fan-made game series (Sailor Moon Plus, Sailor Moon R Ex, Code Name: Sailor V) using the Beats of Rage game engine. The Super Nintendo games are recreated and improved to include new characters, new powers, more levels, in addition to original cinematics and all-new voice talent.
